claims.statement: Tom Allen fought Joe Goss to a draw at Marshfield near Cardiff in 34 rounds, lasting 1 hour 53 minutes.

claims.statement: Tom Allen's right shoulder was dislocated in the twenty-fifth round against Goss, but he fought on.

claims.statement: Tom Allen of Birmingham was twenty-seven years old and five feet ten inches tall at the time of the Goss fight.
